title: iOS PWA keyboard half-stuck layout and broader keyboard/full-screen behavior review
summary: The reported half-stuck iOS/PWA keyboard layout has an implementation and focused browser evidence: shell stays at 732px through closed/focused/blurred states, editor expands/collapses, tab bar returns and overflow restores. Commit 993fc54 is an ancestor of current main, so the fix is integrated. A later related app-switch refresh fix is also included in that commit; its note reports the dev-server cause and focused keep-on-resume regression test, though the thread contains no current real-phone verification. The owner's broader request to review the full-screen keyboard behavior/quirks has no explicit completion evidence. No matching canonical active task was found in the supplied task snapshot.
